title: Plexi CLI descriptor (`--plexi`)
description: Authoritative shape for the JSON document a CLI emits when invoked with `--plexi`. Plexi (and any compatible UI generator) parses this to render a clickable interface for the CLI. v0.x of the format. See docs/specs/proposals/plexi-descriptor.md for the authoring guide.

plexi_version.description: Semver of the descriptor format itself (NOT the CLI version). Major bump = breaking schema change. v0.x parsers reject v1+ descriptors loudly.

name.description: Human-friendly CLI name. Usually matches the binary name.

version.description: The CLI's own version string. Used by registry tier (#321) for cache keys.

description.description: One-line description of what the CLI does.

icon.description: Single emoji or icon glyph rendered next to the CLI name.

default_view.description: Initial render hint when no command is selected. Same enum as command-level ui_hint.

commands.description: Top-level commands. Each command may itself contain nested `commands[]` to model subcommand groups (e.g. `git remote add`).

plexi_app.description: Shell command to spawn as a PGAP process instead of rendering the auto-generated form UI. Split on whitespace: first token is the binary, rest are initial args.

capabilities.description: Capability strings granted to the spawned PGAP process. Same vocabulary as manifest.toml capabilities.

uiHint.description: Render mode: form = inputs+submit, output = run+show result, tabs = grouped subcommands, stream = long-running progress, list = browse children.

argType.description: Argument/flag type. `path` = filesystem path (Plexi may render a file picker). `enum` = constrained choice (must supply enum_values).

outputFormat.description: Free-form hint at the shape of stdout when ui_hint = output. Common values: `text`, `json`, `yaml`, `table`.

liveStateSource.description: Transport Plexi uses to watch external state. `file` = poll path; `socket` = unix socket; `http` = poll URL.

liveStateFormat.description: How Plexi should parse the watched payload.

name.description: Subcommand token as passed on the CLI.

flags.description: Long-form flags. Names should include the leading `--`.

writes.description: Filesystem paths the command may write. Used for trust gating + dirty-state detection.

reads.description: Filesystem paths the command reads. Hint for capability prompts.

streaming.description: True if stdout streams progress over time (vs. one-shot).

commands.description: Nested subcommands. Recursive — a `git`-style multilevel CLI can express `git remote add` as commands→commands→commands.

default.description: Default value if not supplied. Type must be compatible with `type`. Plexi does not coerce — emit the right JSON scalar.

placeholder.description: Hint text rendered inside the input field when empty.

enum_values.description: Required when `type` = `enum`. The complete set of accepted values.

liveState.description: Tells Plexi how to watch out-of-band state changes (e.g. a manifest the CLI mutates while the user is staring at the UI).

path.description: Filesystem path, socket path, or HTTP URL — depending on `source`.

poll_ms.description: How often Plexi re-reads the source. Min 50 ms to avoid busy-looping.
